Currently owned by KKR via its Global Infrastructure Investors Fund III (since July 8, 2020), with Equitix building a stake toward 50% ownership as of December 2025.

summary: Bio Dynamic (UK) Limited operates an anaerobic digestion plant at Colwick Industrial Estate, Nottingham, processing food waste to produce biomethane for grid injection. Ownership recently transferred from Bioganix Holdings (2020-2025) to A.W. Lymn Green Energy (Jan 2026), part of the A.W. Lymn funeral services group. The CSV row shows Air Liquide AB&T UK Ltd as operator, likely referring to biomethane distribution/grid injection functions rather than the AD facility itself.
